messages:
allhands-bot: Live Q&A from today’s all-hands — drop strategy questions for leadership here.
jamie_ceo: Thanks everyone — will answer short ones live and follow up in thread.
sam_product: Quick one: how do we prioritize invest vs. productize for Dedicated vs Hosted next 2 qtrs?
jamie_ceo: Prioritize predictability for enterprise (Dedicated + Private) while keeping Hosted as PLG funnel — heavier investment in SLAs + rollout tooling.
lee_growth: How do we avoid confusing messaging for self-serve customers vs enterprise?
eva_sales: We should surface clear playbooks on use-cases: quick-start hosted, migrate to dedicated when SLOs or compliance required. Docs + templates coming.
olivia_cto: From tech POV: focus on runtime invariants — same API surface, verified perf profiles. That makes messaging factual, not marketingy.
raj_eng: Competitor question: some vendors push "model ownership" as moat — how do we articulate serving-first advantage succinctly?
jamie_ceo: Short answer: owning models is transient; winning is predictable, cost-efficient serving at scale. Our thesis: shift from model custody to serving economics and reliability.
taylor_support: Any guidance for folks getting questions from customers about on-prem vs cloud?
eva_sales: Simple map: regulated/airgapped -> Private; predictable throughput + isolation -> Dedicated; low-friction dev iteration -> Hosted. Shareable diagram in Confluence.
sam_product: Follow-up: can we get a one-pager that sales/PMs can use for positioning?
jamie_ceo: Yes — Sam, please partner with Lee and Eva. I'll review draft.
olivia_cto: One technical note: emphasize our fallback policies (regions, model variants) — customers care about reliability more than raw model bench scores.
lee_growth: Thanks — I’ll draft messaging bullets and examples. :thumbsup:
jamie_ceo: Great thread — if you want deeper dives, ping me or schedule time. We’ll publish a short FAQ after edits.
